sentiment.summary: Fear-driven market (35/100) presents contrarian buying opportunity; no congressional activity or news data to confirm/contradict setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: crisis VIX (394.7), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 22 days create compounded risk for BRK-B.
